VIctor Manuel Isidro Luna Victor Manuel Isidro Luna is an instructor in the School of Economics at the National Autonomous University of Mexico. He obtained a Ph.D. in Economics from the University of Utah (2013) and has numerous articles in journals such as Journal of Economic Issues, World Review of Political Economy, and Ecos de Economía. His main areas of interest are development banks, BRICS, and the role of money in development. Email:u0559410@uofutah.onmicrosoft.com
